annotations.title: Get a tool's inputs and price

description: Free; reads only. Returns everything needed to run one tool: what it does, when to use it and when not, its full JSON input schema with limits, its price per call and price options, its actions (for platform tools such as linkedin or google), an example input and its web page. Call it after search_tools and before run_tool so the input is right the first time.

name.description: The tool's name from search_tools, e.g. 'gpt-image-2-5-sunburst', 'linkedin' or 'weather'.
